$schema_note: Ad-hoc property graph. nodes[] are physical containers (campus > building > floor > unit). edges[] are traversable or containment relations. Every node/edge carries `confidence` and `source` so stale or inferred data is separable from directory-verified data.

meta.subject: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania (HUP), Penn Medicine
primary_sources: HUP Connector wayfinding directory PDF (med.upenn.edu/neurology) - authoritative for PATIENT ROOMS room-number-to-elevator-core mapping and wing floor spans
facilities.upenn.edu HUP building record - authoritative for wing enumeration
pennmedicine.org Pavilion/Clifton 'Getting around' - authoritative for Pavilion room numbering and wing scheme
nursing.upenn.edu HUP Guide to Units (undated, likely pre-2021) - unit assignments, STALE
Penn Nursing NURS 2450 clinical placement list (post-Pavilion) - unit assignments, semi-current
Penn archives / donor recognition - construction dates
known_limitations: Unit-to-floor assignments at HUP Main churn continuously and were massively reshuffled by the Oct 30 2021 Pavilion opening. Treat unit fields as hypotheses, not facts.
No public floor-by-floor directory exists for Maloney or White. Their contents here are inferred from scattered practice-location pages.
Sub-grade tunnel topology is not published. Tunnel edges are asserted from narrative sources only.
The Pavilion was renamed The Clifton Center for Medical Breakthroughs in 2025; both names remain in circulation.

confidence_scale.verified: Stated directly by an official Penn Medicine / Penn Facilities wayfinding or directory document.
confidence_scale.reported: Stated by an official Penn source that is undated or plausibly stale.
confidence_scale.inferred: Derived by reasoning across sources (e.g. room number prefix -> floor).
confidence_scale.unverified: Plausible but unconfirmed; flagged in open_questions.

nodes.name: HUP Main
nodes.note: Not one building but 11+ interconnected wings sharing a single street address and continuous internal circulation. Floor numbers are shared across wings; room number prefix encodes floor.

nodes.name: Founders Pavilion
nodes.note: No 13th floor in the room-number series (5xx, 8xx, 9xx, 10xx, 11xx, 12xx, 14xx). Also holds cath lab, EP lab, pathology, coagulation lab, ORs, and the main cafeteria on 2.

nodes.name: Silverstein Pavilion
nodes.note: Former ED entrance at street level (ED relocated to the Pavilion in 2021). Holds the Intensive Care Nursery, antenatal testing, MFM, obstetrical ultrasound, genetic counseling.

nodes.name: Jonathan Evans Rhoads Pavilion
nodes.note: Entrance off Hamilton Walk. Own room-number scheme (2001-7026 = floor.room). HEPA-filtered onc floor by original design. MRI in basement. Inpatient echo.

nodes.name: Ravdin Institute
nodes.note: Main pedestrian entrance on 34th St; valet. Labor and delivery, second stage recovery, pre-op registration, neurodiagnostic lab, apheresis and infusion, occupational and travel medicine. Ravdin Courtyard addition 1973.

nodes.name: Dulles-Agnew
nodes.note: Only floor 6 carries patient rooms (650-671). Otherwise radiology and the surgical family lounge.

nodes.name: Gates Memorial
nodes.note: Spans 11 floors but appears in NO patient-room range. Spruce St lobby entrance. Dickens Center for Women's Health, sleep medicine, phototherapy.

nodes.name: Maloney Building
nodes.note: Clinical offices and clinics; no inpatient beds (wayfinding directory). Modeled for topological completeness only - office occupants are not tracked.

nodes.name: The Clifton Center for Medical Breakthroughs
nodes.address: 3400 Civic Center Blvd (across 34th St from HUP Main)
nodes.note: floor_span G-17 from the verified floor nodes (Ground lobby node + numbering that reaches 15-17); with 13 modeled as skipped this is exactly 17 stories, matching both the stated story count and OSM building:levels=17.

nodes.name: Perelman Center for Advanced Medicine
nodes.note: Nominally all-outpatient (Abramson Cancer Center, Roberts Proton Therapy Center, specialty clinics), BUT the CHPS inpatient research unit (Center for Human Phenomic Science) occupies overnight research beds here. Any query of the form 'which HUP buildings hold patients overnight' has to include it.

The ground story is continuous under the whole complex: the Connector directory prints a G span only for gates/dulles/ravdin/rhoads, but it labels both the Main Entrance (34th St, Ravdin side) and the Spruce St entrance 'Ground Floor' and the Connector spine 'FIRST FLOOR' — one story above grade. Numbered floors are shared/aligned across wings (see floor_continuity edges), so Silverstein/Founders '1' sits atop a ground story the directory simply doesn't list destinations for (the pre-2021 ED entrance was at Silverstein street level). silverstein/founders/maloney/white membership is inferred; the four G-span wings are verified.
This is the Connector level - the horizontal spine tying HUP Main to PCAM and the Pavilion.

contents: Surgical Intensive Care Unit waiting area (Founders 5, per the March-2022 wayfinding PDF)
nodes.note: EP-23 (2026-08-13): the modeled 24-bed SICU sits on Rhoads 5 (rooms 5001-5024, verified); the Founders-5 attribution is now read as the waiting-area/teaching-room side of the same floor plate. The former 'Founders 5 — SICU' roster entry is retired to archive/ep23_roster_rulings.json.

units_reported: Founders 8 - MICU (opened March 2023, transferring from HUP Cedar MOB 3; EP-23, 2026-08-13)
Silverstein 9 / Ravdin 9 - Pulmonary + GI Medicine + General Medicine (combined unit, post-Pavilion)
Ravdin 9 - Urological, Head and Neck Surgery (pre-2021)
Founders 9 - MICU (until the March-2023 Founders 8 opening per EP-23 evidence — current use of 960-983 unknown, roster entry retired)
nodes.note: Three separate elevator cores serve one floor level here - the densest interlock in the building and the classic wayfinding failure point.

nodes.anomaly: The 1035-1056 range is assigned to the Rhoads elevator, yet the Rhoads wing is documented as spanning only G-7. EP-23 ruling (owner, 2026-08-13): a directory artifact — Penn's own March-2022 wayfinding PDF labels Rhoads 'G-7' in the same document; the line is unchanged since at least an Oct-2019 Wayback capture; and no unit above Rhoads 7 appears in any posting, placement list, or award 2019-2026. The modeled unit and the contested floor-continuity edge are retired to archive/ep23_roster_rulings.json; the range is kept in this transcription because the directory really prints it.

units_reported: Silverstein 11 - General Medicine / Pulmonary / Infectious Diseases (pre-2021)
Founders 12 - Medical Oncology or General Medicine (sources conflict)
nodes.note: Silverstein terminates here. Above level 12, Founders is the only HUP Main tower with beds.
There is no level 13 in the HUP Main room-number series.

units_reported: Hematologic Oncology (pre-2021; liquid onc has since moved to Pavilion 14)
Rhoads 7 - Urology and Colorectal Surgery / General Surgery (post-Pavilion)

contents: Emergency Department (lower of two ED floors)

nodes.note: ED beds are treatment spaces, not licensed inpatient rooms - but they board admitted patients, so include them if your question is 'where do admitted patients physically sleep'.

contents: Interventional platform: 47 operating rooms, procedural suites

nodes.note: Heart and Vascular ICU with an embedded simulation center on the same floor.
12-bed Epilepsy Monitoring Unit with dedicated control room.
Abdominal transplant ICU and floor co-located by design.
Implied by the stated 7-14 patient-room span; no public unit assignment found. Unlike HUP Main, the Pavilion appears not to skip 13.
Building is 17 stories but patient rooms stop at 14; upper levels are mechanical/shell space held for future fit-out.

nodes.name: CHPS Inpatient (Center for Human Phenomic Science)
nodes.access: signposted from the HUP Main Connector, first floor

nodes.name: Surgical Intensive Care Unit (historical Founders-5 attribution)
nodes.note: Original 1987 design placed SICU rooms on a circular plane for single-vantage visibility. EP-23 (2026-08-13): the modeled SICU is the 24-bed Rhoads 5 unit; '5 Founders SICU' survives in fellowship materials as a teaching-room name, so this node is kept as historical record.

edges.name: Silverstein–Clifton skybridge
edges.note: Elevated over 34th St; patients were physically wheeled across on 2021-10-30 during the 310-patient migration. Deck geometry surveyed (KML hand-mapping, 2026-08); level ~3 is inferred (KML LookAt altitude 12.0 m corroborates) — see open_questions.

edges.name: Clifton–Perelman skybridge #1
edges.note: Northern of two parallel decks. Deck geometry surveyed (KML hand-mapping, 2026-08); level ~2 is inferred — see open_questions.

edges.name: Clifton–Perelman skybridge #2
edges.note: Southern of two parallel decks. Deck geometry surveyed (KML hand-mapping, 2026-08); level ~2 is inferred — see open_questions.

edges.name: Dietz and Watson Bridge
edges.note: Directory-verified edge with no KML geometry. The HUP-Main-side anchor at Silverstein (nearest east-block frontage to PCAM; Ravdin east frontage also plausible) is an alignment guess — see open_questions.

edges.name: The Connector
edges.note: Ground/first-floor spine; also the location of admissions, chapel, pharmacy, medical records. The spine threads several HUP Main wings; the Silverstein anchor is the east-block frontage nearest PCAM.
The Connector path is documented as linking all three: HUP Main, Pavilion, PCAM.
Narrative sources describe 'indoor bridges and tunnels'; exact level and alignment unpublished. Wing anchor mirrors the skybridge above (Silverstein is the wing facing the Pavilion across 34th St).
Both built on the former Nurses Home footprint; contiguous on levels 9 and below.
Same numbered floors, different room-number blocks, separate elevator cores. You can walk between them without changing level.

elevator_cores.note: The directory also rides 1035-1056 ('floor 10') on this core — ruled a directory artifact in EP-23 (2026-08-13, owner); see the level-10 anomaly entry and archive/ep23_roster_rulings.json.

open_questions: Dietz & Watson Bridge alignment: which HUP Main wing/frontage the bridge actually lands on (modeled at wing.silverstein as the nearest east-block frontage to PCAM; Ravdin east frontage also plausible), and at what level it crosses.
Bridge levels are estimates tagged inferred, pending on-the-ground verification: Silverstein–Clifton ~level 3 (KML LookAt altitude 12.0 m corroborates); both Clifton–Perelman skybridges ~level 2.

Level-10 anomaly: rooms 1035-1056 are mapped to the Rhoads elevator although Rhoads is documented as G-7. EP-23 ruling (owner, 2026-08-13): treated as a directory artifact — unit and contested edge retired to archive/ep23_roster_rulings.json; the ruling stands unless an on-the-ground check (current floor plan, or a charge nurse on Founders 10) contradicts it.
Pavilion levels 15-17: shelled, mechanical, or occupied? Public sources describe 17 stories but only floors 7-14 as patient rooms.

Whether Maloney or White retain any licensed beds - no source affirms beds, but no source explicitly denies them either. The absence-of-evidence here is from a wayfinding document, which lists only rooms a visitor might be sent to.
Exact level and alignment of the HUP Main to Pavilion tunnel(s).
Whether the pre-2021 unit assignments in this file survive anywhere - most were reshuffled and the Penn Nursing guide has not been redated.
